NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE APPOINTMENT AND POWER RULES UNDER THE
PROHIBITION ENFORCEMENT OF HADD) LIQUOR RULES, 1980
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE APPOINTMENT AND POWER RULES UNDER THE
PROHIBITION ENFORCEMENT OF HADD) LIQUOR RULES, 1980
[Gazette of N.-W. F. P.; Extraordinary, 27th April 1982]
No. 5003/73-D.-In exercise of the powers
conferred by Article 21 of the North-West Frontier Province Prohibition
(Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979 (P. O. No. 4 of
1979) the Government of N: W. F. P., are pleased to appoint officer/officers
and to prescribe their powers under the said Order to the extent noted against
each, as following :-
1.-(i) These rules may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Appointment and Power Rules under the Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979.
(ii) These shall come into force at once.
2. The Senior Member, Board of Revenue, North-West Frontier Province, shall exercise all the
powers of Excise Commissioner as defined in the N: W. F. P., Prohibition
(Enforcement of Hadd) Liquor Rules, 1980.
3. The Director, Excise and Taxation, North-West Frontier Province, shall have all the powers
of a Collector under the Order throughout the Province.
4. The District Excise and Taxation
Officer, Incharge of a District shall be Prohibition
Officer under the provision of the Prohibition (Enforcement of Hadd) Order, 1979 and the Rules made thereunder
:-
5.-(i) Officer
of the following categories are appointed under Article 12 of the Order to
assist the Collector or the Prohibition Officer under whom they may be serving
for the time being, for the .purposes of the Order and the Rules made thereunder :-
(a) An Excise and Taxation Inspector.
(b) An Excise and Taxation Sub-Inspector.
(c) An Excise and Taxation Constable.
(ii) The powers of these officers for
arrest, detention, seizure or other functions under the Order shall stand
mutatis mutandis classified or restricted according to their respective powers
as Excise Officer within the meaning of Rules 55 4 to 55'6 of the North-West
Frontier Province Prohibition Rules, 1949.
(iii) The aforesaid Officers of
Categories (a) and (b) shall exercise the powers of a Police Officer under
Chapter XIV of the Cr. P. C., 1898 (No. V of 1898), while conducting
investigation in a cognizable offence under the Order.
